1:
set -eu
DB=/config/calibre-server/users.sqlite
mkdir -p /config/calibre-server/tmp
/app/calibre/calibre-server --userdb "$DB" --manage-users -- remove "$CALIBRE_SERVER_USER" 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s' "$CALIBRE_SERVER_PASSWORD" | /app/calibre/calibre-server --userdb "$DB" --manage-users -- add "$CALIBRE_SERVER_USER"
chown -R 568:568 /config/calibre-server

0:
[[runners]]
  [runners.docker]
    tls_verify = false
    image = "docker:stable"
    disable_cache = false
    volumes = ["/certs/client", "/cache"]
    pull_policy = ["if-not-present"]
    allowed_pull_policies = ["always", "if-not-present"]
  [runners.kubernetes]
    image = "ubuntu:latest"
    pull_policy = ["if-not-present"]
    allowed_pull_policies = ["always", "if-not-present"]
  [[runners.kubernetes.volumes.empty_dir]]
    name = "docker-certs"
    mount_path = "/certs/client"
    medium = "Memory"
  {{- if .Values.global.minio.enabled }}
  [runners.cache]
    Type = "s3"
    Path = "gitlab-runner"
    Shared = true
    [runners.cache.s3]
      ServerAddress = {{ include "gitlab-runner.cache-tpl.s3ServerAddress" . }}
      BucketName = "runner-cache"
      BucketLocation = "us-east-1"
      Insecure = false
  {{ end }}

1:
- name: gitlab-setup-script
  secret:
    secretName: gitlab-webservice-setup-script
    defaultMode: 0500
    items:
      - key: setup.sh
        path: setup.sh

- name: gitlab-setup-script
  mountPath: /var/run/secrets/gitlab-setup/setup.sh
  subPath: setup.sh
  readOnly: true
